title: Combined-Program Credit Rates by How the Wraparound Seat Is Paid
content:
**Funding schedule.** Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the combined-program credit owed to a tuition-based Pre-K child who attends Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) depends on how the child's active Pre-K Wraparound seat in the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program is paid.

| The child's active Pre-K Wraparound seat | Credit |
|---|---|
| funded by Workforce Solutions Child Care Services (the seat's subsidy payer is Workforce Solutions Child Care Services) | 20.00, in place of 40.00 |
| family-paid, and the seat's latest Creek Kids Club tuition charge for the billing month (by posted date) carries the free meal rate, reduced meal rate or employee rate as its rate basis | 25.00 |
| any other seat, including a family-paid seat whose latest tuition charge for the billing month carries the standard rate | 40.00 |

The billing month is the Pre-K enrollment's most recent billing month. The rate basis is read from the seat's own Creek Kids Club tuition charge for that billing month; where more than one is posted, the one with the latest posted date is read.

## Reading the seat's records (hypothetical seats)

| Subsidy payer on the seat | Rate basis of the seat's latest tuition charge for the month | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Workforce Solutions Child Care Services | standard rate | 20.00 |
| none (family-paid) | reduced meal rate | 25.00 |
| none (family-paid) | employee rate | 25.00 |
| none (family-paid) | standard rate | 40.00 |
